notes: Candidate experiment only; does not overwrite the BillSum-based dataset, checkpoint, or results.
Bloom transformation uses the canonical BloomShift final candidate corpus.
Summarization source is ccdv/arxiv-summarization, document configuration; complete articles and abstracts are retained only when the complete SFT sequence fits within 8192 tokens.
Candidate dataset uses 495 summarization training examples to preserve the 40/30/30 training mix and 114 examples per task for validation/test, without replacement.
ArXiv dataset card does not declare one blanket license for every underlying paper. Review dataset/source paper rights before redistribution or making broad licensing claims.
Run dataset preparation and strict QC before training. Do not tune hyperparameters after inspecting held-out test metrics.
